barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.description: Negate all damage the first time I take damage each round

bloodthirsty.name: Bloodthirsty
bloodthirsty.description: When I kill a unit, restore x HP

last-one-standing.name: Last One Standing
last-one-standing.description: If I am the only ally unit, I have +x HP

lethal.name: Lethal
lethal.description: When I damage another unit, kill it

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.description: When I kill a unit, Destroy x

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.description: When I take damage from a unit's ability, deal x damage back

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.description: Round end: heal me x HP

resilient.name: Resilient
resilient.description: I take -x damage from all sources

ruthless.name: Ruthless
ruthless.description: I deal +x damage if the enemy has less than 10 lighthouses

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: I can target any enemy unit

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: Enemies are forced to target me if they can

undying.name: Undying
undying.description: When I would die, I survive with 1 HP instead

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.description: I deal +x damage if I am missing HP
